svg.text: V-28 · CSR requirement diagram · configuration lock and release firmware
CSR-C-01…CSR-C-02 of WP-S-07 §4: status, parent, allocation, shared safety mechanisms and cases
Release panda firmware for the reference configuration shall
accept a car safety mode only if model, parameter and alternative experience equal the compile-time
locked values recorded in the release record.
allocated FW · verified by R, UT, HIL
A rejected safety-configuration request shall leave the panda in a
non-actuating mode and set a fault flag reported to the SoC in the health packet.
allocated FW · verified by UT, HIL
Transitions from the locked car mode to SILENT or NOOUTPUT
shall remain permitted at all times.
allocated FW · verified by UT, HIL
While a car safety mode is active, release firmware shall reject host
commands outside a documented allow-list, including relay drive (0xc5), CAN mode/speed changes (0xdb,
allocated FW · verified by R, UT, FZ
Alternative experience shall not be changeable in release firmware
pandad shall compare the panda-reported safety model, parameter
and alternative experience with the release-record values and prevent engagement and raise an alert on
allocated SoC · verified by UT, HIL
The release panda firmware and bootstub shall be built with
RELEASE and the LionDriver certificate, and the release build shall fail if ALLOW_DEBUG is defined.
allocated FW; ENV · verified by BA
The release bootstub shall not contain the debug public key and
shall accept no key other than the LionDriver release key.
allocated FW · verified by BA, HIL
Debug-only host commands (relay drive 0xc5, ALLOUTPUT mode,
bootloader entry, debug sleep) shall be absent from release firmware.
allocated FW · verified by BA, R, FZ
Softloader entry (0xd1 param 1) shall be accepted only while the
panda is in a non-actuating mode and no car mode has been active in the current ignition cycle (refused
after a drive this ignition cycle).
allocated FW · verified by UT, HIL
No debug capability in release firmware
